data.display_address: Lagoon Views, District One, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience modern waterfront living in this brand-new 3-bedroom apartment located in Lagoon Views at District One. Offering spacious interiors and premium finishes, this residence is ideal for families seeking comfort, convenience, and scenic surroundings.

The property features a total size of 2,397.66 sq.ft with a built-up area of 2,410 sq.ft, thoughtfully designed to maximize space and natural light.

Property Highlights:

Brand new unit
Unfurnished
3 spacious bedrooms
4 modern bathrooms
Maid’s room
Ready to move in
Flexible payment: 1–4 cheques
Balcony with Burj Khalifa and community views
Fully fitted kitchen with appliances
Built-in wardrobes
Two covered parking spaces
Access to shared swimming pool and fitness facilities

Located in the prestigious District One community, residents enjoy beautifully landscaped surroundings, crystal lagoon access, cycling and jogging tracks, and excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai and major road networks.

This home offers a perfect blend of luxury, space, and prime location—an excellent choice for both end-users and investors.
